metadata.question: Was the PM2.5 level higher in February 2020 than in February 2019 within a 50km radius of (40.923221, 104.238631)?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: I need to query PM2.5 data for February 2020 and February 2019 around the coordinates (40.923221, 104.238631). This is in China (Lanzhou area). GEE has MERRA-2 data which includes PM2.5 estimates. 2. Masking strategy: PM2.5 is a direct measurement/estimate, not satellite imagery with clouds, so no cloud masking needed. 3. Logic: - Retrieve MERRA-2 PM2.5 data for Feb 2019 and Feb 2020 - Calculate mean PM2.5 for each period - Check for valid pixels (count > 0) - Compare values: if Feb2020 > Feb2019, answer A; else B - Handle edge cases: no data (C1), no valid pixels (C2), invalid results (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define geometry: 50km radius around (40.923221, 104.238631) const lon = 104.238631; const lat = 40.923221; const point = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]); const geom = point.buffer(50000); // 50km radius // Load MERRA-2 PM2.5 data const merra2 = ee.ImageCollection('MERRA2/MONTHLY'); // Filter for February 2019 const feb2019 = merra2 .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2019, 2019, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')); // Filter for February 2020 const feb2020 = merra2 .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2020, 2020, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2, 2, 'month')); const size2019 = feb2019.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = feb2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2019 Images: ${size2019}`); console.log(`Feb 2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2019 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log('No data found for one or both months.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Mean composite for each period const img2019 = feb2019.mean(); const img2020 = feb2020.mean(); // Select PM2.5 band const pm25_2019 = img2019.select('PM25'); const pm25_2020 = img2020.select('PM25'); // Calculate mean and pixel count for Feb 2019 const stats2019 = pm25_2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: geom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9, }); const mean2019 = stats2019.get('PM25_mean').getInfo(); const count2019 = stats2019.get('PM25_count').getInfo(); // Calculate mean and pixel count for Feb 2020 const stats2020 = pm25_2020.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), null, true), geometry: geom, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9, }); const mean2020 = stats2020.get('PM25_mean').getInfo(); const count2020 = stats2020.get('PM25_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2019: Mean=${mean2019}, Pixels=${count2019}`); console.log(`Feb 2020: Mean=${mean2020}, Pixels=${count2020}`); // Validate data if (count2019 === 0 || count2020 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after processing.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (mean2019 === null || mean2020 === null || isNaN(mean2019) || isNaN(mean2020)) { console.log('Calculation resulted in invalid values.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare PM2.5 levels console.log(`Comparison: Feb2020 (${mean2020.toFixed(2)}) vs Feb2019 (${mean2019.toFixed(2)})`); if (mean2020 > mean2019) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
